verdict.rationale: smolagents is a Python library with a minimal-code agent creation API, CLI utilities (smolagent, webagent) for running agents without boilerplate, step-by-step execution control, sandboxed Docker/E2B/Modal execution options, and OpenTelemetry instrumentation for run inspection — all of which support running in CI/headless pipelines. Missing for 10: no explicit CI pipeline example (e.g., GitHub Actions), no independent report of production CI usage, and no explicit headless-mode documentation.
